unit.why: A single narrative about the match and marriage of R. Yehiel Michel of Zloczow and his wife Rachel's poverty and devotion.

stories.start_quote: חותנו של הה״ק רבינו ר׳ יחיאל מיכל
stories.summary_en: R. Yitzhak of Drohobych arranges a match for his son R. Yehiel Michel with the daughter of the villager R. Moshe, who pledges his tavern equipment for the dowry. R. Yehiel Michel forgives the debt when his wife weeps over it, lives secluded and comes home only from Sabbath to Sabbath, and his wife lives in deep poverty and brings him whatever she earns.

quotes: ועשה שידוך עם בת ר׳ משה הנ"ל
וקבע זמן הנשואין אחר שנים עשר חודש
tags.why: the match and wedding are the frame of the story
his father, father-in-law and wife all appear

quotes: המכונות והכלים שהי׳ לו וויין הויז
tags.why: the father-in-law ran a wine house in the village
the father is called the Mokhiah (preacher)

quotes: ישב בבית ההתבודדת ולא יצא לביתו
tags.why: he is given a separate house for seclusion and lives there

quotes: הית׳ עניה כ״כ שלא הי׳ לה מנעלים
ראה הה״ק רי״מ את זו׳ הרבנית רעכיל בוכת
tags.why: the relationship between husband and wife is depicted

quotes: ומה שהיתה משתכרת לפעמים היתה מביאה
tags.why: the wife Rachel acts: she weeps, pleads for her parents and supports her husband
the wife weeps over her parents' distress
he forgives the dowry pledge out of compassion

quotes: אורו זורח מסוף עולם ועד סופו
tags.why: the father declares the son's hidden spiritual stature
the story illustrates the tsaddik's seclusion and the couple's self-sacrifice

quotes: ולא יצא לביתו רק משבת לשבת
tags.why: he stays away from his wife and home all week
